root_cause.text: Missing serialization (mutex) in `vfio_cdx_set_msi_trigger()` allows concurrent `VFIO_DEVICE_SET_IRQS` ioctls to race on shared state (`vdev->config_msi`, `vdev->cdx_irqs`, `vdev->msi_count`), resulting in a use-after-free of the `cdx_irqs` array when one thread frees it while another still references it.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "vfio_cdx_set_msi_trigger() reads vdev->config_msi and operates on the vdev->cdx_irqs array based on its value, but provides no serialization against concurrent VFIO_DEVICE_SET_IRQS ioctls. Two callers can race such that one observes config_msi as set while another clears it and frees cdx_irqs via vfio_cdx_msi_disable(), resulting in a use-after-free of the cdx_irqs array." The patch adds `cdx_irqs_lock` mutex to `struct vfio_cdx_device` and acquires it in `vfio_cdx_set_msi_trigger()` to serialize all updates.
